environment.description: Rails 7.0 application deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer). Session-based authentication using Rails encrypted cookies. PostgreSQL 15 database with RLS policies defined but the application database role is the table owner (has BYPASSRLS privilege). SameSite cookie attribute set to 'None' for cross-origin dashboard embedding. No CSRF token verification on API endpoints. Application accessible from any origin.
